content.worksheet_title: STRUCTURE USE — Grammar (The Syntax Blueprint of Operations)
content.guia_header: IMARPOR-CC · Guía 1 · The Maritime Operations Pro · Nivel A1.2 · Sesión 3

bilingual_instruction_block.main_message_en: Today, you become Andrea's grammar partner. You discover two patterns hidden in yesterday's manual: WHERE things are on the vessel, and WHAT happens during each shift. By the end, you will write your own shift notice for Berth 4.
bilingual_instruction_block.main_message_es_cursiva: Hoy, te conviertes en el compañero gramatical de Andrea. Descubres dos patrones escondidos en el manual de ayer: DÓNDE están las cosas en el buque y QUÉ sucede en cada turno. Al final, escribirás tu propio aviso de turno para Atraque 4.

the_syntax_blueprint.title_en: THE SYNTAX BLUEPRINT — Two Patterns of the Port
the_syntax_blueprint.title_es: EL PLANO SINTÁCTICO — Dos Patrones del Puerto

examples_from_master_anchor_text_s2: There is a bridge ON TOP.
Captain Lopera is IN the bridge.
The dock is IN FRONT OF the warehouse.
blueprint_1_prepositions_of_place.pattern_visual: Subject → BE → PREPOSITION → Location · ej: 'The crew is ON the deck.'
blueprint_1_prepositions_of_place.micro_capsula: > ⚠️ **Grammar Rule:** Use ON for surfaces (on deck, on the bridge). Use IN for closed spaces (in the cabin, in the bridge). Use AT for points (at Berth 4, at 07:00). (*Usa ON para superficies. Usa IN para espacios cerrados. Usa AT para puntos.*)

examples_from_master_anchor_text_s2: The crew loads containers on deck.
Captain Lopera leaves the bridge at 19:00.
blueprint_2_simple_present_operations.pattern_visual: He / She / It + verb-s · I / You / We / They + verb · ej: 'The captain ARRIVES. The aprendices ARRIVE.'
blueprint_2_simple_present_operations.micro_capsula: > ⚠️ **Grammar Rule:** Add -s when the subject is HE, SHE, or IT (one vessel, one captain, one container). NO -s for I, you, we, they. (*Agrega -s cuando el sujeto es ÉL, ELLA o ESO.*)

archetype_A_DISCOVERY_CR.name_es: DESCUBRIMIENTO Y CONCIENCIA — Encuentra el Patrón
archetype_A_DISCOVERY_CR.actua_como: Grammar Discovery Coach & ESP Inductive Grammar Specialist
archetype_A_DISCOVERY_CR.rationale_a12: Discovery funciona con A1.2 cuando el corpus es controlado (6-8 oraciones del Master Anchor Text S2 ya conocidas). El aprendiz no inventa de cero — extrae el patrón de datos que ya leyó ayer. Bloom L2-L3 (entender, aplicar) sin pasar a L4 análisis abstracto.

pre_discovery.title_es: PRE — Activa el texto de ayer
pre_discovery.instruction_en: Look at this corpus from Andrea's manual. Read each sentence in pairs. Do NOT translate. Just notice.
pre_discovery.instruction_es_cursiva: Mira este corpus del manual de Andrea. Lee cada oración en parejas. NO traduzcas. Solo observa.
corpus_for_discovery: 2. There is a bridge ON TOP.
4. Captain Lopera is IN the bridge.
5. The crew is BEHIND the captain.
6. The lifeboat is IN FRONT OF the bridge.
8. The crew loads containers on deck.
9. Captain Lopera leaves the bridge at 19:00.

task_1_pattern_a.instruction_en: In sentences 1-6, circle ALL the small words that tell you WHERE things are (e.g., on, at, in...). Write the rule in your own words.
task_1_pattern_a.instruction_es_cursiva: En las oraciones 1-6, encierra TODAS las palabras pequeñas que dicen DÓNDE están las cosas. Escribe la regla en tus propias palabras.
task_1_pattern_a.rule_formulation_frame_en: When I want to say WHERE something is, I use ____________ before the place.

task_2_pattern_b.instruction_en: In sentences 7-10, underline the verb. Look at the END of each verb. What letter do you see? Why?
task_2_pattern_b.instruction_es_cursiva: En las oraciones 7-10, subraya el verbo. Mira el FINAL de cada verbo. ¿Qué letra ves? ¿Por qué?
task_2_pattern_b.rule_formulation_frame_en: When the subject is one person/thing (HE/SHE/IT), the verb ends with ____________.

verification_step.instruction_en: Captain Restrepo confirms your rules. Compare with the official Syntax Blueprint above.
verification_step.instruction_es_cursiva: Capitán Restrepo confirma tus reglas. Compáralas con el Plano Sintáctico oficial arriba.

categorization_check.instruction_en: Mark each new sentence as CORRECT (✓) or INCORRECT (✗). Justify in 1-3 words.
categorization_check.instruction_es_cursiva: Marca cada oración nueva como CORRECTA (✓) o INCORRECTA (✗). Justifica en 1-3 palabras.

items.sentence: The captain are on the bridge.
The crew is at the dock.

connection_to_pm29_functions.instruction_en: Why do we need these structures? Match each function to the structure.
matches: Locate equipment / crew on the vessel → Prepositions of place (Gr7)
Describe what happens in a shift → Simple present (Gr9)

archetype_B_CONTROLLED_PRACTICE.name_en: CONTROLLED PRACTICE — Drills That Build Muscle Memory
archetype_B_CONTROLLED_PRACTICE.name_es: PRÁCTICA CONTROLADA — Drills que Construyen Memoria Muscular
archetype_B_CONTROLLED_PRACTICE.actua_como: Grammar Drill Specialist & ESP Accuracy Trainer
archetype_B_CONTROLLED_PRACTICE.rationale_a12: Práctica controlada es ideal para A1.2 cuando se acaba de descubrir la regla (Archetype A). Drills cortos y enfocados automatizan la forma antes de pedir uso libre. Bloom L1-L2 (recordar, aplicar) — perfecto para techo L3 sin sobrepasar.

presentation.instruction_en: Look at the Syntax Blueprint above. Keep it open. The formula stays visible during all drills.
presentation.instruction_es_cursiva: Mira el Plano Sintáctico arriba. Mantenlo abierto. La fórmula permanece visible durante todos los drills.

drill_1_substitution.name_en: Substitution Drill — Same structure, different objects
drill_1_substitution.instruction_en: Replace the underlined word. Keep the rest of the sentence the same.
drill_1_substitution.model_sentence: The captain is ON the bridge.
substitutions: The crew is ___ the deck. (preposition: on)
The container is ___ the dock. (preposition: at)
The lifeboat is ___ the captain. (preposition: behind)
Andrea is ___ the warehouse. (preposition: in front of)
The mentor is ___ the bridge. (preposition: in)

drill_2_gap_fill.instruction_en: Complete with the correct form of the verb in parentheses (simple present).
items: 4. Andrea and Restrepo ____________ (start) the shift at 06:00.
6. We ____________ (work) at the Port of Buenaventura.
7. The captain ____________ (not / leave) the bridge during berthing.
8. ____________ (do) the crew load containers every morning?

drill_3_sentence_building.instruction_en: Order the words to build a correct sentence about Andrea's shift.
items: 2. on / the / are / containers / deck / there

production_minimal.title_en: PRODUCTION — Three sentences of your own
production_minimal.instruction_en: Write THREE sentences about your imagined first shift at Berth 4. Use one preposition of place and two simple present verbs.

archetype_C_COMMUNICATIVE_TASKS.name_en: COMMUNICATIVE GRAMMAR TASKS — Where is Captain Lopera?
archetype_C_COMMUNICATIVE_TASKS.name_es: TAREAS GRAMATICALES COMUNICATIVAS — ¿Dónde está Captain Lopera?
archetype_C_COMMUNICATIVE_TASKS.actua_como: Task Grammar Designer & ESP Communicative Structure Specialist
archetype_C_COMMUNICATIVE_TASKS.rationale_a12: Information Gap atrapa prepositions de manera natural — el aprendiz NECESITA preguntar y responder dónde están las personas y objetos en el buque para completar el diagrama. La estructura no se enseña; se REQUIERE para resolver la tarea. Bloom L3 con scaffolds.

task_briefing.title_en: BRIEFING — A radio drill at Berth 4
task_briefing.title_es: INFORME — Un simulacro radial en Atraque 4
task_briefing.scenario_en: It is 08:00 at Berth 4. The BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS is docked. Captain Restrepo asks each pair: 'Where is everyone? Where is the cargo?' Student A has half the diagram. Student B has the other half. Find each other's information.
task_briefing.scenario_es_cursiva: Son las 08:00 en Atraque 4. El BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS está atracado. Capitán Restrepo pregunta a cada pareja: '¿Dónde está cada persona? ¿Dónde está la carga?' Estudiante A tiene la mitad del diagrama. Estudiante B tiene la otra mitad. Encuéntrense la información.

knows: Captain Lopera is ON the bridge.
The crew is ON the deck.
The cargo is IN the warehouse.
The lifeboat is IN FRONT OF the bridge.

task_execution.bloom_level: L3 (Apply) — la estructura emerge de la necesidad comunicativa

language_focus_post_task.title_en: LANGUAGE FOCUS — Notice what you used
language_focus_post_task.title_es: FOCO LINGÜÍSTICO — Nota lo que usaste
language_focus_post_task.instruction_en: After the task, count: how many times did you use a preposition of place? Which one was hardest?
language_focus_post_task.instruction_es_cursiva: Después de la tarea, cuenta: ¿cuántas veces usaste una preposición de lugar? ¿Cuál fue la más difícil?
reflection_questions: Which preposition did you use most? (probably ON or AT)
Did you use 'in front of' or 'behind'? Why or why not?
Did you use simple present too? When?

archetype_D_CREATIVE_PRODUCTION.name_es: PRODUCCIÓN CREATIVA — El Aviso de Turno de Andrea
archetype_D_CREATIVE_PRODUCTION.actua_como: Creative Grammar Producer & ESP Structure-Through-Story Specialist
archetype_D_CREATIVE_PRODUCTION.rationale_a12: Sentence Combining es accesible para A1.2 — fusiona oraciones simples (que el aprendiz ya domina) en oraciones más completas usando prepositions y simple present. La 'creatividad' es controlada: el aprendiz inventa SU propio shift notice con la misma estructura del modelo S2. Bloom L3 con frames.

warm_up.instruction_en: Look at the Syntax Blueprint one more time. Notice: prepositions tell WHERE; simple present tells WHAT happens.
model_examples: The vessel arrives at 07:00 at Berth 4.
Captain Lopera leaves the bridge at 19:00.

creative_production_step_1_sentence_comb.title_en: STEP 1 — Combine simple sentences into operational sentences
creative_production_step_1_sentence_comb.title_es: PASO 1 — Combina oraciones simples en oraciones operativas
creative_production_step_1_sentence_comb.instruction_en: Combine each pair of sentences using a preposition + simple present. Add small details if needed.

pair: The vessel arrives. The time is 07:00. The location is Berth 4.
items.expected: The vessel arrives at 07:00 at Berth 4.

pair: Captain Lopera leaves the bridge. The time is 19:00.
items.expected: Captain Lopera leaves the bridge at 19:00.

pair: The crew loads containers. The location is on deck. The time is 09:00.
items.expected: The crew loads containers on deck at 09:00.

pair: The cargo is in the warehouse. The cargo moves to deck.
items.expected: The cargo moves from the warehouse to deck.

creative_production_step_2_own_shift_not.title_es: PASO 2 — Escribe TU aviso de turno
creative_production_step_2_own_shift_not.instruction_en: Imagine you work the night shift at Berth 5. Write a 5-line shift notice using the model below. Use at least 3 prepositions of place + 4 simple present verbs.

evaluation.title_en: EVALUATION — Was it correct AND creative?
evaluation.note: Pasa directamente a Archetype E (peer review) sin transición — la edición es la evaluación final del producto creativo.

archetype_E_EDITING_ERROR_ANALYSIS.name_en: EDITING & ERROR ANALYSIS — Be Your Own Grammar Police
archetype_E_EDITING_ERROR_ANALYSIS.name_es: EDICIÓN Y ANÁLISIS DE ERRORES — Sé Tu Propia Policía Gramatical
archetype_E_EDITING_ERROR_ANALYSIS.actua_como: Grammar Editor & ESP Error Analysis Specialist
archetype_E_EDITING_ERROR_ANALYSIS.rationale_a12: Editing es metacognición concreta para A1.2 — el aprendiz no inventa errores, los detecta en una lista finita y predecible (5 errores típicos de prepositions + agreement). Bloom L3 (Apply) sin pasar a L4 análisis abstracto. La auto-corrección transfiere directamente a PM-2.4 Writing.

exposure.title_es: EXPOSICIÓN — Un aviso de turno con errores
exposure.instruction_en: This shift notice from a former apprentice has 6 grammar errors (prepositions + simple present). Find them all.
exposure.instruction_es_cursiva: Este aviso de turno de un ex-aprendiz tiene 6 errores gramaticales (preposiciones + presente simple). Encuéntralos todos.
exposure.buggy_text: SHIFT NOTICE — Berth 4 — Morning. The BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS arrive at 07:00 in Berth 4. Captain Lopera is at the bridge. The crew load containers in deck. Andrea and Restrepo is behind the captain. The cargo are in the warehouse. The shift end at 14:00.
expected_errors: 2. 'in Berth 4' → 'at Berth 4' (point in space, not closed container)
3. 'is at the bridge' → 'is on the bridge' (surface, not point) [aceptable también 'in the bridge' como cabina]

diagnosis.instruction_en: For each error, classify: PREPOSITION (P) / AGREEMENT (A) / VERB-S (V). Justify in 1 sentence.

transfer.title_en: TRANSFER — Apply to your own shift notice (Archetype D)
transfer.title_es: TRANSFERENCIA — Aplica a tu propio aviso de turno (Archetype D)
transfer.instruction_en: Trade your shift notice with a partner. Use the Self-Editing Checklist.
self_editing_checklist: ☐ Every -s on verbs with HE/SHE/IT subjects
☐ Every preposition correct (ON for surfaces, IN for closed, AT for points)
☐ Every plural subject has plural verb
☐ Every name capitalized (Andrea, Captain Lopera, Berth, BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS)

self_reflection_prompt.prompt_en: Which error is your most frequent? How will you avoid it next time?
self_reflection_prompt.prompt_es_cursiva: ¿Qué error es el más frecuente en ti? ¿Cómo lo evitarás la próxima vez?

rotation_options_for_instructor.title_en: INSTRUCTOR ROTATION MENU — Session 3 Grammar Flow Options
rotation_options_for_instructor.title_es: MENÚ DE ROTACIÓN DEL INSTRUCTOR — Opciones de Flujo Gramatical Sesión 3
rotation_options_for_instructor.total_direct_time_available: 2.0h (120 min) de la sesión 3 dedicadas a PM-2.10 (PM-2.4 Writing ocupa el resto · ~4h del bloque de 6h)

sequence: 5 min → Bilingual instruction + Syntax Blueprint walkthrough
30 min → Archetype A (Discovery) — descubrir prepositions y -s
30 min → Archetype D (Creative Production) — write own shift notice
recommended_flow_options.rationale: Clásico A1.2: descubrir → automatizar → producir. Cierra alimentando PM-2.4 con shift notice como pre-producto.

sequence: 25 min → Archetype C (Information Gap) — la gramática emerge en pares
25 min → Archetype B (Controlled Practice) — automatización post-task
30 min → Archetype D (Creative Production) — own shift notice
recommended_flow_options.rationale: Para grupos comunicativos. La gramática se necesita ANTES de explicarse. Útil cuando el grupo tolera ambigüedad inicial.

sequence: 20 min → Archetype E (Editing) — buggy shift notice + self-checklist
recommended_flow_options.rationale: Útil si grupo cohorte previa mostró errores sistemáticos. Prioriza metacognición sobre producción libre. La Archetype D queda para autonomous work.

sequence: 10 min → Bilingual instruction + Syntax Blueprint whole-class
5 stations × 20 min rotating (A, B, C, D, E)
recommended_flow_options.rationale: Máxima cobertura del menú gramatical. Requiere instructor + capitán mentor (2 facilitadores) o peer-led stations.

rotation_options_for_instructor.autonomous_work_0_66h: Todos los aprendices completan Archetype D (own shift notice 5 líneas) + Archetype E (self-editing checklist aplicada al producto propio) como trabajo autónomo si no se cubrió en sesión directa. Reportan en Moodle como pre-producto que PM-2.4 Writing consumirá.

transferencia_to_pm24.instruction_en: The grammar you discovered today (prepositions + simple present) becomes the engine of PM-2.4: you will write Andrea's full shift report for the BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS. The structures you automated here will appear in the writing rubric.
structures_handed_to_pm24: Gr7 prepositions of place (in/on/at/under/behind/in front of)
Gr9 simple present 3rd person -s (arrives, leaves, loads, departs, starts, ends)

grammar_targets_for_pm24.purpose: PM-2.4 Writing (S3 segunda mitad) consume estos targets como criterios de la rúbrica de escritura del shift notice / shift report del aprendiz. Cada target debe aparecer al menos N veces en el producto escrito final.

targets.example_required: containers ON deck / captain ON the bridge
vessel AT Berth 4 / shift ends AT 14:00

targets.structure: Gr7 prepositions of place — closed/relative (IN / BEHIND / IN FRONT OF)
targets.example_required: cargo IN the warehouse / lifeboat IN FRONT OF the bridge

targets.structure: Gr9 simple present — 3rd person singular with -s
targets.example_required: vessel arrives / captain leaves / crew loads
I work / we load / they depart
The dock is wet / Andrea is the apprentice

targets.structure: Gr4 there is / there are (consolidated from S2)
targets.example_required: There are containers on deck / There is a bridge on top

grammar_targets_for_pm24.writing_product_to_consume_targets: Andrea's shift report for the BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS at Berth 4 (8-12 lines, A1.2)
grammar_targets_for_pm24.rubric_alignment_pm24: PM-2.4 deberá incluir en su rúbrica la celda 'Grammar Accuracy' que evalúa GT-S3-01 a GT-S3-07 con peso 30% del producto escrito

activities.statement: Descubrir inductivamente las dos estructuras gramaticales de la sesión (Gr7 prepositions of place y Gr9 simple present de operaciones) a partir de un corpus de 10 oraciones del Master Anchor Text S2 sobre el Puerto de Buenaventura, formulando las reglas en sus propias palabras y verificándolas con Captain Restrepo (Archetype A — Discovery & Consciousness-Raising)
activities.didactic_technique: Investigación guiada — Consciousness-Raising Tasks + Rule Formulation

activities.statement: Automatizar las dos estructuras mediante práctica controlada (Substitution Drills, Gap-Fills sobre operaciones del BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS, Sentence Building con vocabulario portuario) y/o tarea comunicativa de Information Gap sobre la posición de tripulantes y carga en el buque, alcanzando producción mínima de 3 oraciones propias (Archetypes B + C combinables)
activities.didactic_strategy: Aprendizaje basado en tareas + Práctica estructurada
activities.didactic_technique: Taller — Drills + Information Gap (combinable según rotation_options FLOW-1 o FLOW-2)

activities.statement: Producir un shift notice propio de 5 líneas (Berth 5 night shift) usando ≥3 prepositions of place + ≥4 simple present verbs y aplicar Self-Editing Checklist sobre el propio producto + el de un compañero, identificando y clasificando errores típicos (preposition / agreement / verb-s) — pre-producto que alimenta PM-2.4 Writing (Archetypes D + E combinables)
activities.didactic_strategy: Producción creativa con control + Análisis de errores
activities.didactic_technique: Taller — Sentence Combining + Peer Review + Self-Editing Checklist

evidence.description: PM-2.10 es actividad de scaffolding cognitivo · NO genera evidencia formal. Sus ítems se cosechan para el Cuestionario consolidado S6 (5 puntos del bloque Grammar). El pre-producto (own shift notice + self-editing checklist) alimenta directamente PM-2.4 Writing como insumo.
